Forgery-proof palm vein recognition unlocks the door in just 0.6 seconds with 99.9% accuracy. Your palm vein data is stored securely on the device, so your privacy stays intact.

A 2K HD camera with an f/1.6 lens stays sharp even at night, and a 150° head-to-toe video doorbell removes blind spots so you can check packages and visitors. Real-time alerts tell you who is at the door, whether you are at home or away.
Check the front door at any time from the screen on the inside of the lock, with no smartphone app needed. Its simple, intuitive layout suits older people and children.
A rechargeable battery runs the lock for up to 4 months of full functionality. An emergency set of 4 AAA batteries adds another month of essential functions during a power cut.

Works with the eufy ecosystem and HomeBase 3 for advanced AI security, and supports Matter for secure connections with Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa and SmartThings. Camera streams are not available over Matter, and this lock is not compatible with HomeBase 2.
